lupus.name: Lupus (Wolf)
lupus.description: A young, slender black wolf with sleek fur and sparkling amber eyes. This is her natural form and she is most comfortable and at peace as a wolf, away from human civilization.

homid.name: Homid (Human)
homid.description: Petite 5'1" woman, appearing about 18 years old. Honey-colored, slightly wavy medium-length hair with curtain bangs. She wears wide-leg jeans, sneakers, boxy cropped sweater in dusty rose. River has an air of shy innocence and even naivete at times, but she watches and learns everywhere she goes. She is still trying to get more comfortable in human form and interacting with humans in their busy, noisy world.

crinos.name: Crinos (Werewolf)
crinos.description: As a werewolf, River is about 8.5' tall with dark, sleek fur reminiscent of wet stones in a river. Her jet-black fur flows down her back like rushing water, and she has bits of bone and river-polished stones interwoven in her coat that catch the light of the moon. Her eyes are amber, flashing with fire like the sunset just as it disappears behind the mountains she calls home. She moves very gracefully, flowing forward like the rush of river rapids, but she is astonishingly silent as she moves with quiet rage, ready for the fight.

homid.name: Homid (Human)
homid.description: Broad-shouldered Russian man, messy beard, heavy worn leather jacket.

crinos.name: Crinos (Werewolf)
crinos.description: Terrifying 8-foot hulking wall of dark fur, broad shoulders, massive claws.

lupus.name: Lupus (Wolf)
lupus.description: Massive black timber wolf with noticeable battle scars across the muzzle.

appalachianWoods.name: Appalachian Woods of Tennessee
appalachianWoods.description: Misty Appalachian forest in the Great Smoky Mountains of Tennessee. Maples, redbuds, and dogwoods flourish beneath the canopy of tall oaks and pines. Dappled light filters through the canopy above and the mist. A river with rapids flows on one side.

urbanChattanooga.name: Urban Chattanooga at Night
urbanChattanooga.description: City alleyway, cracked asphalt, brick walls with peeling paint, rusted steel fire escapes, dumpster, murky water puddles, dark moody lighting.

caern.name: Caern
caern.description: A hidden glade surrounding a moonlit natural spring, ancient carved stones marked with glowing Garou glyphs, ethereal spirit fog.
